utterances.speaker: Project Manager
utterances.text: Okay, let's start. Today we need to decide on the price and the battery for the remote control.

utterances.speaker: Industrial Designer
utterances.text: From the market research, I propose a selling price of 35 euros.

utterances.speaker: User Interface
utterances.text: 35 seems high for a remote.

utterances.speaker: User Interface
utterances.text: Yeah, I think customers would not pay that much.

utterances.speaker: Project Manager
utterances.text: What about the battery? Any suggestions?

utterances.speaker: Industrial Designer
utterances.text: I suggest a lithium battery, it is more sustainable.

utterances.speaker: User Interface
utterances.text: Lithium sounds good to me.

utterances.speaker: Marketing
utterances.text: I agree, lithium fits the trendy image.

utterances.speaker: Project Manager
utterances.text: Okay, so we go with the lithium battery. That's decided.

utterances.speaker: Marketing
utterances.text: Back to the price, maybe we should go lower.

utterances.speaker: Project Manager
utterances.text: Let's change the price to 15 euros instead, that is our final decision.

utterances.speaker: Industrial Designer
utterances.text: Okay, 15 is fine with me.

utterances.speaker: User Interface
utterances.text: Yes, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Project Manager
utterances.text: Now the case material. Should it be rubber or plastic?

utterances.speaker: Industrial Designer
utterances.text: Rubber is better for the double curved case.

utterances.speaker: User Interface
utterances.text: But rubber is more expensive.

utterances.speaker: Project Manager
utterances.text: We will not decide the case material today, let's leave it open until the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Project Manager
utterances.text: Action items. The Industrial Designer will prepare a prototype of the battery design by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Industrial Designer
utterances.text: Okay, I'll do the prototype by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Project Manager
utterances.text: The User Interface designer will draw the button layout after the prototype is ready.

utterances.speaker: User Interface
utterances.text: Sure, I will draw the button layout once the prototype is done.

utterances.speaker: Project Manager
utterances.text: And Marketing will send the trend report on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Marketing
utterances.text: Yes, I'll send the trend report on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Project Manager
utterances.text: Good. The meeting is closed. See you next time.
